facts.text: Pendry Park City is a ski-in / ski-out resort in the center of Canyons Village, steps from the high-speed Sunrise Gondola.
facts.excerpt: A ski-in / ski-out resort nestled in the center of Canyons Village and just steps from the new high-speed Sunrise Gondola

facts.text: The Sunrise Gondola gives guests high-speed service from Canyons Village to Red Pine, steps from the guestrooms.
facts.excerpt: offering Pendry Park City guests high-speed service from Canyons Village to Red Pine, just steps from your guestroom

facts.text: The Sunrise Gondola's 10-person cabins offer sweeping mountain views and trailhead access.
facts.excerpt: Board a 10-person cabin for sweeping mountain views, trailhead access and endless outdoor adventure above it all.

facts.text: The guestrooms and suites use natural, warm design elements with a contemporary, modernist feel that pays homage to the mountain landscape.
facts.excerpt: pay homage to the mountain landscape with natural, warm design elements made anew with a contemporary, modernist feel throughout.

facts.text: The guestrooms have views of the Utah landscape and the surrounding resort.
facts.excerpt: our inspired guestrooms provide striking views of the Utah landscape and surrounding resort

facts.text: The suites have kitchenettes, a nook seating area and designer amenities.
facts.excerpt: The elegant accommodations offer spacious kitchenettes, a nook seating area and designer amenities.

facts.text: Each residence has bedroom and living areas, a fully equipped kitchen and a marble bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Each residence offers exceptional bedroom and living areas, fully equipped kitchens and spacious marble bathrooms.

facts.text: Spa Pendry is a mountainside spa that welcomes both hotel guests and locals.
facts.excerpt: Welcoming hotel guests and locals alike to our mountainside spa hideaway where simplicity and serenity intersect in style.

facts.text: The private fitness center is open 24/7 and has Peloton and TechnoGym equipment.
facts.excerpt: our 24/7 private fitness center, featuring state-of-the-art equipment, including Peloton, TechnoGym and more

facts.text: The Pool House offers rooftop dining and drinks with panoramic mountain views.
facts.excerpt: The Pool House offers rooftop dining and drinks with panoramic mountain views

facts.text: Après Pendry, the slopeside lobby lounge and bar, has fireside seating and live music.
facts.excerpt: the lobby lounge and bar offers fireside seating, live music and a menu of shareable signature favorites

facts.text: KITA is a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and sushi restaurant.
facts.excerpt: KITA, a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and premium sushi restaurant

facts.text: Dos Olas serves Mexican classics with a coastal California influence.
facts.excerpt: Dos Olas sits alongside the slopes with a menu of Mexican classics and contemporary shareable favorites blending traditional flavors and cuisine with a coastal California influence

facts.text: Paintbox, the children's program, offers custom activities, events and arts and crafts tailored to each child's age and interests.
facts.excerpt: Paintbox keeps your youngest travelers engaged and inspired all day with custom activities, events, arts & crafts and more, tailored to their age and personal interests

facts.text: Mountain biking in summer is just steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From ski-in / ski-out access in winter to world-class mountain biking in summer, just steps from Pendry.

facts.text: Event spaces include a grand ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Park City stuns with signature indoor and mountainside spaces, including a grand ballroom

facts.text: In-room dining offers breakfast, lunch, dinner and late-night fare.
facts.excerpt: allowing guests to enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner and late-night fare delivered directly to their guestroom

facts.text: Accessible rooms have a bathroom with grab bars and a roll-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Accessible accommodations are appointed with an accessible luxury bathroom, featuring grab bars and roll-in shower

facts.text: The hotel describes Spa Pendry as world-class.
facts.excerpt: Spa Pendry is a signature, world-class beauty and wellness haven
